title: X-ray Attenuation Workbench
description:
A local graphical and programmable workbench for narrow-beam X-ray attenuation in multicomponent materials and planar multilayers: glasses, ceramics, composites and filters.

From chemical composition (mass, mole or volume fractions) and density, it computes energy-dependent mass and linear attenuation coefficients, transmission and removed fraction, photoelectric, coherent and incoherent contributions, half- and tenth-value layers, attenuation lengths and the thickness needed for a target transmission, over 1–800 keV with sampling around absorption edges. It also evaluates measured photon spectra, propagates density and thickness uncertainty by Monte Carlo, and includes a materials library whose every entry records its source.

Cross-sections are the Elam, Ravel & Sieber (2002) data via XrayDB; please cite that work as well. Version 1.0.0 supersedes the 0.1.x calculator, whose multicomponent results double-counted mass fractions.
